description: Source code for managing a whitelist of origin-domain pairs in WebKit, including parsing JSON data, requesting whitelist info from WPEFramework, and adding entries to WebKit.

classes.name: JSONEntry
classes.description: Represents a JSON object for origin, domain, and subdomain information used in parsing whitelist JSON data.

methods.name: ParseWhiteList
methods.description: Parses JSON string containing whitelist data and populates the internal whitelist map.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::RequestFromWPEFramework
methods.description: Requests whitelist data from WPEFramework via a synchronous message and parses the JSON response.

methods.name: WhiteListedOriginDomainsList::AddWhiteListToWebKit
methods.description: Adds the stored whitelist entries to WebKit as origin access whitelist entries.
